notes.title: Introducing… Linda & Joan Zine Club!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37450633/4728430314fd6e858cd303c00368849b64c9c57f.gif

Join Zine Club! A companion project for the forthcoming video game Linda & Joan. 


 Receive ten handcrafted zines — each with bonus items — in the mail over the next year or so
 Learn backstory about the real family that inspired the game Linda & Joan
 Form a deeper understanding of the characters, situations, and objects you’ll discover in the final game
 Use the zines to solve in-game puzzles and play scenes only accessible to Zine Club members
 Support independent art and the development of Linda & Joan


>> JOIN TODAY <<
